protocol_alignment.conclusion: Shared TIG task/supervision/control interface as a declared BPP humanRGB adaptation; not a compute-matched reproduction or a numerical reproduction of paper baseline tables.

adaptation_validity.scope: Read-only v1 source and existing numerical artifacts
adaptation_validity.confirmed_issue: Unclipped quantile-normalized action targets versus DDIMclip1 output support. Controller clip_count0 does not exclude internal sampler clipping.
adaptation_validity.recipe_omissions: V1 native training omitted source input perturbation and EMA updates. Released original HF state_dicts.model already held EMA; source weight-key selection was correct.
adaptation_validity.causality_limit: These issues motivate the accepted v2 recipe, but their success-rate contribution is unmeasured.

capability_scope.prompt_controls: Existing C15 Seen/L0 diagnostic20rollouts and40offline predictions support prompt-dependent first actions on10fixed states.
capability_scope.limit: Single trainseed; small Seen diagnostic with training-pool human clips. No isolated human-domain/embodiment effect, complete temporal imitation or unseen-human generalization established.

c45_failure_analysis.scope: Archived v1 static logs/numeric labels/checkpoint metadata; no new rollouts
c45_failure_analysis.not_located: Trigger layer/sample and causal contributions remain unidentified.
c45_failure_analysis.AdamW_caveat: Gradient clipping coefficient is not a same-factor parameter-update reduction and is not evidence of frozen parameters.
c45_failure_analysis.v2_status: Minmax+inputperturb0.1+EMA repairs are not yet a demonstrated solution. Module gradient and clipping-coefficient telemetry is part of main training, not an extra ablation.
